oracle: ISA-derived behavioral checks plus upstream reference lineage; never derive expected data solely from candidate RTL.

criteria.acceptance: Ordinary supported zero-element instructions eventually produce the required architectural completion; a silent decode drop, host timeout or forced reset fails.

Initialize memory, destination registers and v0 independently; compare state and accepted memory element transactions for zero-VL operations. Check defined CSR effects such as vstart reset separately.
Cross legal SEW8/16/32, integer/fractional LMUL, vl=0/1/short/VLMAX, supported vstart, masks, operation classes and backpressure. Whole-register transfers and scalar moves have separate expectations.
Illegal encodings stay subject to the ISA exception rule at vl=0. A valid nonzero operation after zero-element traffic must retire with correct data.
Detect repeated issued-PC/no retirement and command/retirement imbalance. Retry only infrastructure failures; retain the failing seed/trace and do not turn an RTL deadlock into a pass.

uvm_components: AXI master/slave agents and control agent
Requirement-linked covergroups and reviewed exclusion ledger
